notes.title: Easter Special
notes.content:
[h1]Easter Special[/h1]

Hello everyone!

The Easter Special is live. And Carl and his friends are getting a visit from Mr. Bunny, who helps them secure the last veggies. Easter, eggs can also be found on every map, making the game easier... or not!

Check it out and see what's new! The Easter Special is from April 15th to April 25th, so hurry up and save the vegetables!

Orange Sloth Games

[h2]Update Log 1.3.1[/h2]

[h3]New Character[/h3]
[b]Mr. Bunny[/b] is a mean bunny who will help you with his egg cannon and eggsplosive surprises.

[b]Trait:[/b]
Joy of Easter
- You have a 20% chance of dropping eggs, which serve as explosive mines.

[b]Special:[/b]
Eggsplosion
- Throw a joyful-looking egg-shaped hand grenade that deals area damage.

[h3]Egg Hunt[/h3]

You have a 75% chance of finding Easter eggs on every map, which give you buffs, permanent or otherwise. Sometimes good, sometimes bad.

[b]Egg 1:[/b]
You receive between $10 and $40.

[b]Egg 2:[/b]
You receive 15 health points.

[b]Egg 3:[/b]
You receive 2 maximum health points (permanent).

[b]Egg 4:
You receive 1% increased movement speed (permanent).

[b]Egg 5:
You receive 2 more damage (permanent), but also a 5% chance of a fatal fart.

[h3]Other New Features[/h3]
Game engine updated to the new Unity version 6 (therefore more memory).

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed a bug where you couldn't level up new characters with a controller.
- Adjusted the color of the toxic storm.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.2.0
notes.content:
[h1]UPDATE 1.2.0 – Free to Play [/h1]

Hello Players!
It has been a long time since the last Update and it has been a while since I had some news for you. I have been quite busy this year with other things, so game development was not my priority and then other projects have come up and caught my attention more than The Last Veggies.  But here I am again bringing you a big Update and some other news:

The Last Veggies will now be [b]Free to Play[/b], starting today until forever! 

Yes, you heard right. I appreciate all your support throughout the release and in the early access phase of the game. But The Last Veggies has not reached as many people as I intended to and has cost me more time and other resources than I planned. So instead of taking it down from Steam the game will now be free to play, hoping that more users will join to fight the monsters and save humanity! This way my playerbase can grow and my next title can start with more interested players right away. I will still publish hotfixes from time to time but new content will only be available every now and then. 

So now to the Update itself. There have been plenty of changes regarding the balancing and game difficulty. New features have been added and a seasonal character is joining the crew for this December! The full log can be found below!
 
That’s it for now! Until next time. ːsteamhappyː
OrangeSlothGames 


[h2]New Content[/h2]

[h3]Santa:[/h3]
Santa is a new seasonal character and he can be unlocked for 2 golden carrots. He brings a new trait and 2 new random specials. 

[b]Hole in the bag (Trait):[/b]
Santa has a 20% Chance to drop a gift out of his bag that will act like an explosive mine. 

[b]Candycane Madness:[/b]
Santa reduces his firerate to a minimum for a short period of time.

[b]Power of Christmas:[/b]
Santa deals 20% more damage when he has full health. 

[h3]The Shop is calling:[/h3]
-	at the end of a wave a phone will pop up on the bottom of the screen 
-	interacting with the phone (y / n) will open the shop or close the phone 
-	no need to run to the shop and waste useful time 

[h3]Skip Lever:[/h3]
-	a lever has been added to Gamemode 2 The Last Veggies 
-	pull the lever (like harvesting vegetables) to skip the time between waves 
-	no more waiting time for those fast paced action junkies 

[h3]Glitter:[/h3]
-	glitter will now fall from the sky whenever you level up a character 
-	makes the level up look even more fresh 

[h2]Balancing: [/h2]

[h3]Enemies:[/h3]
-	lowered all Monster HP by 10% 
-	lowered all basic monster damage by 10%
-	Raiders also deal 10% less damage 
-	Raiders also have 10% less health 
-	Gamemode 1 lowered the increase of enemy health in higher waves from 3 % to 2%
-	Gamemode 2 removed the increase of enemy health in higher waves 
-	Gamemode 3 increased the increase of enemy health in higher waves from 1 % to 2%

[h3]Events:[/h3]
-	Reduced the Health points of the Bounty Hunter Monster by 10% 
-	Changed the firerate of the Bounty Hunter Monster 1sec to 1.5sec
-	Removed the “Toxic Storm” Event in Gamemode 2 as this was leading to an unfair experience 

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
-	Fixed the price error for level ups (it is now 5 as intended)
-	Fixed several spelling mistakes in german localization (but more are coming)

notes.title: The Last Veggies Update 0.7.8.2
notes.content:
Hi Players! ːsteamhappyː

I hope you all had a great couple of weeks and enjoyed the gamescom live or on twitch. As I have mentioned before this weeks update will not bring any new features to the game but it will fix some bugs and prepare the game for what is coming. I have been working on a couple of issues the last week and I have managed to fix almost all of them. I have been working on the performance of the game as there have been some issues since the last update. Furthermore this update will bring small visual improvements regarding the effects and the combat in the game. I have tried to make combat more fun by implementing some new effects and improving some that were already there. Besides that I have started to change some parts of the UI but it is not quite done yet which will lead to the information that I am going to share right now. 
Making a game is difficult and especially when you are working on it alone. I have not always achieved the best results in terms of usabilty in my game and so I have learned more about that topic and [b]the game will have a complete overhaul[/b] in terms of usabilty. In the next weeks I will focus on [b]changing the UI and the players interaction with it,[/b] especially with the gamepad. This will hopefully lead to a much better experience when playing the game and it will also [b]improve the look and feel[/b] of it as well. So after the next Update the game might look a but different.
Check the list below for a more detailed information about this weeks update! 

I hope you like the changes I made and I wish you all a great weekend! 
Orange Sloth Games

notes.title: The Last Veggies - Content Update 0.7.6.0
notes.content:
[h1][b]Content Update 0.7.6.0[/b][/h1]
Hi Players! I know it has not even been a week since release and I wanted to update the game every one or two weeks but a couple of recent events have led to this early content update.

Lets start with the less great news first. A couple of players have experienced bugs with the steam Achievements and progress in the game as they had more than one user on the same Pc. I have adressed this issue now and everything is working smoothly no matter how many user you have on one Pc. Other than that there have been a number of bugs reported to me and I have reacted as fast as possible and removed all of them (for now?). 

And now the good stuff. I have been working on some new content as well and rather than waiting another week I have uploaded all of that in this update as well! So there are a few new features and even a new character for you to dicover! For more information you can read the detailed report below! 

I wish you all a great weekend! ːsteamhappyː

- fixed a graphic bug of the turret showing it upside down

- fixed an issue where the player was not able to press any buttons with the gamepad after completing the mission 
- fixed the localization issue with the Success Overview at the end 

[b]Tractor(item):[/b]
- fixed the localization issue in the item description

- fixed the bug with the number of kills and trucks that have been delivered (works properly now)

- changed the process for steam how achievements are unlocked and saved as there were issues with multiple accounts on one device
